components.title: Session-ID capture and resume (warm path)
components.summary: Persist AgentResult.session_id from agent stdout; thread --resume flag through consensus_wrapper.py invoke_agent_for_event. Resume reuses prompt-cached session; handles missing cursor gracefully.

components.title: Restart-phase BRC memory preservation
components.summary: Salvage BRC memory files alongside commits in agent_salvage.py auto_salvage_pipeline() before worktree deletion. Stores to .egg-state/salvaged-memory/<pipeline-id>/<role>/brc-memory-<id>.md.
files: orchestrator/agent_salvage.py (new salvage_brc_memory function, hook in auto_salvage_pipeline)

components.title: Deterministic factual seed layer
components.summary: Orchestrator derives review anchors from message record (never agent-transcribed). New seed_composer.py module reads tracker state and committed BRC history to render per-producer last-reviewed SHA, verdicts, NACK reasons, obligations.
files: orchestrator/routes/event_prompt.py (new keyword-only seed_prompt arg in compose_event_prompt)

components.title: Agent-authored enrichment seed layer
components.summary: Read BRCMemory files from .egg-state/agent-outputs/<role>/brc-memory-<id>.md; extract key findings, producer narrative, decision trail; SHA-stamp each claim for stale detection via git-log delta cross-reference.

components.title: System-prompt injection through wrapper
components.summary: Thread --system-prompt flag through build_event_pump_wrapped_command → agent_prefix_parts in the wrapper template. Mutually exclusive with --resume (warm path). Seed composed as stable, cacheable bytes injected at agent spawn time.

components.title: Deterministic rendering discipline
components.summary: Sorted keys, hard per-section caps (2KB deterministic, 1KB enrichment), no timestamps, no random UUIDs, trimmed trailing whitespace for prompt-cache stability across restarts.

open_questions: Resume-vs-seed tiebreaker: wrapper bash vs agent client-side? (Proposed: wrapper bash)
Cross-role seed: should a restarted agent receive all roles' enrichment, or only its own?
Seed granularity: per-session stable prefix vs per-event recompilation? (Proposed: per-session)

risks.risk: Propagation error (wrong belief in seed amplifies)
risks.mitigation: SHA-stamp + git-log delta cross-ref for stale detection
Sorted keys, hard numeric caps, no timestamps, strip whitespace

risks.risk: Provider mismatch on resume (full-price cache miss)

risks.mitigation: CI gate requires target SDK version pass
Hard cap at composition, trunc with sentinel
